5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION

CALL TO ORDER
Mayor/Chairperson Rebollo

ROLL CALL
City Clerk Shumway

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS
Citizens wishing to address the City Council and Successor Agency on any item on the Closed Session agenda
may do so at this time.  Please complete a speaker's card and give it to the City Clerk /Secretary prior to
commencement of the City Council/ Successor Agency meetings. Please limit your remarks to three (3) minutes.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

1.  THREAT TO PUBLIC  SERVICES  OR  FACILITIES,  PURSUANT  TO  GOVERNMENT
  CODE SECTION 54957

  Consultation with: City Manager, Assistant City Manager, City Attorney, and other related
  City officials.
2.  Pursuant to Government Code §54956.8, the City Council will confer with its real property
  negotiator, Edgar Cisneros, with respect to real estate negotiations for properties located
  at 5476 Jillson St. (APN 6335-019-023), 5530 Jillson St. (APN 6335-019-042), 2500 S.
  Eastern Ave. (APN 6335-024-046), (APN 6335-024-03), (APN 6335-024-039), (APN

  6335-024-045), 5600 Jillson St. (APN 6335-023-049), (APN 6335-023-0), (APN
  6335-023-054), 5611 E Washington Blvd. (APN 6335-023-048), 5571 E. Washington Blvd.
  (APN 6335-024-056), (APN 6335024057), and 5555 E. Washington, Commerce, CA
  90040.
3.  Conference with Legal Counsel - Existing Litigation - Pursuant to Government Code
  Section 54956.9(d)(1).  One (1) case:  ZVI (aka) Harry Ryzman and Betty Ryzman, as
  Trustees of the Ryzman Family v the City of Commerce, acting in a separate limited
  capacity elected to serve as the Successor Agency to the Commerce Community
  Development Commission et al. - Superior Court of the State of California, County of Los
  Angeles, Case No. 19STCP02821.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

ADJOURNMENT

AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Rebollo called meeting to order at 5:02 p.m.

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council on any items on Closed Session agenda. 

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION The City Council recessed to Closed session at 5:03 p.m.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION City Council reconvened to Open Session at 7:45 p.m.

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT City Attorney Tapia reported on Closed Session items:

Item #1 & #2 - staff provided a presentation , City Council provided feedback, and no reportable action was taken on any of these items.

Item #3 -was not discussed.  

ADJOURNMENT Meeting adjourned at 7:46 p.m. in memory of Hector Viva Avila, father -in-law of Councilmember Altamirano and John Alvarez, former Parks and Recreation commissioner.  

Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings) in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California, and the City's website.
